scope_note: 69 official product IDs: the existing Enduro/Forerunner scope plus all35 fenix device targets installed on2026-10-26. Includes every fenix6/6S/6X standard, Pro, Sapphire and Solar variant represented by official device metadata. Capability data is read independently from Garmin device packages; no dependency on another watchface. Product support is distinct from simulator, store export or physical-device validation.
api_note: Regional part numbers may advertise API 1.3.1. The manifest minimum of 1.4.0 excludes those regional firmware versions; a product ID is not a claim that every region or firmware is supported.
resource_note: White official logos on black; four gray levels where supported. Sizes shared with devices whose resource palette lacks555555 orAAAAAA use only black and white. Launcher dimensions are independent of screen width.
